name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: SOAP request received matching {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} condition (OrderTypeCode = YORB)
expected_outcome: Message routed through CallActivity_102 (Mapping) and CallActivity_13 (Generic Headers Logging) terminating at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200 OK acknowledgement.
validates: Routing condition SequenceFlow_82, payload transformation mapping, custom header enrichment, and successful message termination.

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Alternative Happy Path)
trigger: SOAP request received matching {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} condition (OrderTypeCode = POR)
expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 (Generic Headers) without mapping, completing at EndEvent_9.
validates: Routing condition SequenceFlow_113, header propagation, bypass of MessageMapping_1, and clean delivery to SO Return endpoint.

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End Event
trigger: SOAP request with OrderTypeCode not meeting SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder predicates (e.g., UNKNOWN_TYPE)
expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110, triggering Escalation End Event (EndEvent_11) with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
validates: Exclusive gateway default path routing and escalation event generation without silent message loss.

name: Malformed XML Inbound - Exception Subprocess Activation
trigger: Non-well-formed XML SOAP Envelope posted to /Glovia_SalesOrder endpoint
expected_outcome: Message parsing failure triggers SubProcess_91, restores original payload via CallActivity_97, executes Log_Payload (1).gsh, and terminates with EndEvent_95 (Error End).
validates: Exception subprocess capture, original payload restoration from exchange property 'InputPayload', and error logging script execution.

name: Mapping Transformation Failure Handling
trigger: Well-formed SOAP message matching SalesOrder route but missing mandatory target mapping fields (e.g. invalid date formats)
expected_outcome: Message Mapping step CallActivity_102 raises a mapping exception, routing control to SubProcess_91, capturing InputPayload property and failing via EndEvent_95.
validates: Message mapping resilience and failure recovery delegation to exception subprocess.

name: Boundary & Whitespace OrderTypeCode Handling
trigger: SOAP envelope with order code containing trailing spaces and boundary code 'PLM '
expected_outcome: Evaluator normalizes or strictly routes depending on configured externalized parameters; tests defensive trimming.
validates: Condition evaluation robustness against un-sanitized sender payload values.
